==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Equip all [[ghostly robes]], the [[ring of visibility]] and a [[Ghostspeak amulet]].
*Talk to the ghost of [[General Khazard]], north of the log balance, south-east of [[Rellekka]]. (Fairy ring {{fairycode|CJR}} if 48 agility, otherwise {{fairycode|AJR}} is faster) {{Chat option|Any|1 I'm a very trustworthy person.}}
*Talk to [[Sin Seer]] in [[Seers' Village]]. She is upstairs in the spinning wheel house. You need an empty inventory spot and 40 coins. {{Chat option|Any|1 Here's the money.}}
*Return to [[General Khazard]].
*Talk to the ghost [[Scout (Shantay Pass)|Scout]] south of [[Shantay Pass]]. (Fairy ring {{fairycode|BIQ}} and run east)
*Talk to the ghost [[Scout (Tree Gnome Stronghold)|Scout]] south of the [[Gnome Stronghold]] entrance. Use a [[Spirit tree]] or a [[Necklace of passage]] to the Outpost.
*Talk to the ghost [[Scout (Falador)| Scout]] in the area between [[Falador]] and [[Draynor Manor]]. Use an [[Explorer's ring 2]] or better to teleport south of him.
*Talk to the ghost [[Scout (Tai Bwo Wannai)|Scout]] east of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]], south of the hardwood grove. (Fairy ring {{fairycode|CKR}} and run north-east) or [[Tai bwo wannai teleport]] and run east.
*Return to [[General Khazard]].
*Prepare for battle against a level 160 [[Bouncer (ghost)|Bouncer]] (You need to have the [[Severed leg (The General's Shadow)|severed leg]] in your inventory to enter the wall)
*Enter the [[Goblin Cave]] east of the [[Fishing Guild]].
*Run to the north-east area and enter the crack in the southern wall.
**You '''cannot''' use prayer in this cave.
*Lower Bouncer's health to 0 and your character will automatically throw the [[Severed leg (The General's Shadow)|severed leg]].
*'''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''}}
